records.name: 变温实验控制后端与界面组件
records.name_en: Variable-Temperature Experiment Control Backend and GUI Component
records.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于协调 Keithley 2400、Keithley 2182 和 Lakeshore 350 的连接、配置、温度斜坡控制、测量采集以及实验界面状态管理，适合变温电学测量流程。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component that coordinates connection, configuration, temperature ramp control, measurement acquisition, and GUI state management for a Keithley 2400, Keithley 2182, and Lakeshore 350 in variable-temperature electrical measurement workflows.

records.name: 固体分装机
records.description: Virtual Solid Dispenser for Add Protocol Testing - supports mass and molar additions

records.name: 垂直反射镜模拟组件
records.description: 非物理软件组件，用于在实验控制中模拟双支撑/双千斤顶垂直反射镜的运动与几何换算。它支持原始执行量与派生镜面参数之间的转换，并可按派生目标参数进行设定，适合测试控制逻辑与坐标变换。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component that simulates a two-support/two-jack vertical mirror for experiment control. It converts between raw actuator values and derived mirror parameters, and allows the mirror state to be set using derived targets, making it useful for testing control logic and coordinate transforms.

records.name: 带ROI统计功能的面阵探测器
records.description: 用于实验成像的面阵探测器系统，可采集二维图像并对感兴趣区域（ROI）进行强度或计数统计。常用于同步辐射束线、X射线成像和通用扫描实验中的在线监测、快门联动与文件存储。
records.description_en: A 2D area detector system for experimental imaging that acquires images and computes intensity or count statistics in selected regions of interest (ROIs). It is commonly used in beamline, X-ray, and general scan-based experiments for online monitoring, shutter coordination, and file saving.

records.name: 旋转蒸发仪
records.description: Virtual Rotary Evaporator for EvaporateProtocol Testing

records.name: 热释电测量后端
records.description: 用于热释电实验的非物理软件组件，负责协调 Lake Shore 350 温度控制器与 Keithley 6517B 的连接和初始配置，执行起始温度稳定、温度斜坡控制，并读取温度与电流测量数据，同时为图形界面提供日志、输入区和曲线显示等支持。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component for pyroelectric experiments. It coordinates connection and initial configuration of a Lake Shore 350 temperature controller and a Keithley 6517B, performs start-temperature stabilization and temperature ramp control, acquires temperature and current readings, and supports GUI functions such as logging, input panels, and graph display.

records.name: 珀金埃尔默面阵探测器
records.description: 一种用于实验室二维成像测量的面阵探测器，常见于X射线成像、散射或衍射实验中，用于采集连续图像帧并记录样品的二维信号分布。
records.description_en: An area detector for laboratory 2D imaging measurements, commonly used in X-ray imaging, scattering, or diffraction experiments to acquire image frames and record the two-dimensional signal distribution from a sample.

records.name: 离散PI控制器
records.description: 一种执行比例-积分反馈调节的数字控制单元，根据设定值与测量反馈之间的偏差计算控制输出，并带有积分防饱和处理。可用于实验室中的温度、位置、光功率或其他过程量的闭环稳定控制。
records.description_en: A digital control unit that performs proportional-integral feedback control. It computes a control output from the error between a setpoint and a measured feedback value, with anti-windup handling for the integral term. It is suitable for closed-loop stabilization of temperature, position, optical power, or other process variables in laboratory setups.

records.name: 自制液-液分离器
records.description: 液-液分离器设备，基于自制Grbl控制器的自动化分离系统。该设备集成搅拌、沉降、阀门控制和电导率传感器，通过串口通信实现精确的分离操作控制。支持自动搅拌、分层沉降、基于传感器反馈的智能分液等功能。适用于有机化学中的萃取分离、相分离、液-液提取等需要精确分离控制的实验应用。

records.name: 被动监测实验界面与通信组件
records.name_en: Passive Monitoring GUI and Communication Component
records.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于被动监测实验中的仪器通信与图形界面控制。它负责连接并协调 Keithley 2400 与 Lake Shore 仪器，执行实验配置、读取测量数据、记录日志，以及管理界面状态与实验流程。
records.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for instrument communication and GUI control in passive monitoring experiments. It connects and coordinates a Keithley 2400 and a Lake Shore instrument, handling experiment configuration, measurement retrieval, logging, and UI workflow management.

records.name: 被动监测实验界面后端
records.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于被动监测实验的界面与通信协调。它负责通过 VISA 连接并配置 Keithley 2400、Keithley 2182 和 Lakeshore 温控相关仪器，读取测量值与温度数据，并管理实验启动、停止、日志和界面状态。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component for coordinating the GUI and instrument communication in a passive monitoring experiment. It connects to and configures Keithley 2400, Keithley 2182, and Lakeshore temperature-control-related instruments over VISA, acquires measurement and temperature data, and manages experiment start/stop, logging, and UI state.

records.name: 超导持久磁体线圈
records.description: 这是一种带持久开关与加热器的超导磁体线圈，用于低温与量子器件实验中产生稳定磁场。实验时通常先由外部电流源给线圈充电，再切换到持久模式以在断开电源后维持磁场，并可进行失超检查、电流与磁场换算以及磁场缓慢扫场控制。
records.description_en: This is a superconducting magnet coil with a persistent switch and heater, used in cryogenic and quantum-device experiments to generate stable magnetic fields. The coil is typically energized by an external current source and then switched into persistent mode so the field can be maintained after disconnecting the source. It supports quench checking, current-field conversion, and controlled field ramping.

records.name: 非持久模式磁体线圈
records.description: 一种在非持久模式下工作的磁体线圈，用于在实验中产生和调节磁场。此类线圈通常通过外部电流源连续供电，常见于低温测量、量子器件表征及其他需要可控磁场偏置的实验。
records.description_en: A magnet coil operated in non-persistent mode, used to generate and adjust magnetic fields in laboratory experiments. This type of coil is typically driven continuously by an external current source and is commonly used in cryogenic measurements, quantum device characterization, and other setups requiring a controllable magnetic field bias.
